question: How many CFI-G normal gas flames went out by themselves, and over what oxygen range?
claim: Of 179 CFI-G normal gas flames, 102 went out by themselves (self-extinguished) at oxygen levels from 17.968567% to 39.97%, and 31 ended when the fuel flow was stopped.
summary_student: In the CFI-G experiment on the space station, more than half of the small gas flames went out on their own instead of being switched off. They did so over a wide range of oxygen levels, from below to well above the level in normal air.
summary_professional: ACME CFI-G (PSI-159) normal-flame table: 179 tests; outcome se (self-extinguished) in 102 and ft (flow terminated) in 31; the rest have no outcome recorded. XO2 before test for self-extinguished flames: 17.968567–39.97% (n = 102).

params.sql: SELECT 'psi159_normal_tests' AS name, count(*) AS value, 'tests' AS unit, investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row) AS source_rows, list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.outcome')) AS source_columns FROM tests WHERE source_table = 'PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal Flames.csv' GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT 'psi159_normal_self_extinguished', count(*), 'tests', investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row), list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.outcome')) FROM tests WHERE source_table = 'PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal Flames.csv' AND outcome = 'se' GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT 'psi159_normal_flow_terminated', count(*), 'tests', investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row), list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.outcome')) FROM tests WHERE source_table = 'PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal Flames.csv' AND outcome = 'ft' GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT 'psi159_normal_self_extinguished_o2_min', min(o2_pct_min), '% O2', investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row), list_distinct(list_concat(list(json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.outcome')), list(json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.o2_pct_max')))) FROM tests WHERE source_table = 'PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal Flames.csv' AND outcome = 'se' GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT 'psi159_normal_self_extinguished_o2_max', max(o2_pct_max), '% O2', investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row), list_distinct(list_concat(list(json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.outcome')), list(json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.o2_pct_max')))) FROM tests WHERE source_table = 'PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal Flames.csv' AND outcome = 'se' GROUP BY investigation, source_table

method.formula: The values returned by the SQL query in params, one row per value, each with the source rows it used.

assumptions: "se" and "ft" in the column "Self-ext or flow term" are read as self-extinguished and flow terminated.
Oxygen is the "XO2 before test" mole fraction, read as a percentage.
limitations: Covers only the CFI-G normal-flame table; inverse flames are not included.
Counts how flames ended; it does not say why each one went out.
Pressure and fuel mixture also differ between tests and were not held equal.
